collection.title: Ford Capri SUV 2024 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ford Capri 2024 Onwards requires a 28" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 16" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
